Priya: Heads-up — started onboard run for qr_4b-int8 and hitting a weird paraphrase-heavy regression on rerank-bench-v2. MRR down ~-5% overall, bigger on >512 token docs. saving notes here. :thinking:
Diego: can you drop the exact numbers and the sample ids from the failing shard?
Priya: MRR -4.9%, Recall@10 -6.0% on the full shard. failing sample ids: [pair_A12, pair_B34, pair_C56]. sampling cmd: `python infra/sample_cohort.py --cohort=rerank-onboard --strategy=shingle --n=1200 --seed=2026`
Noor: shingle was added to capture paraphrase groupings; it can overweight near-duplicates if k is small. run shingles and diff: `tools/shingle_hash --k 4 --input onboard.json --out onboard_shingles.json` then `python tools/shingle_diff.py prod_shingles.json onboard_shingles.json --top 50`
Eric: also suspicious: our onboard FAISS build used hnsw efConstruction=64 for speed. suggest rebuilding with efConstruction=200 and compare recall curves. command: `python infra/faiss_rebuild.py --index rerank-onboard --ef 200 --store /tmp/ef200.index`
Taylor: golden set contains ~78 paraphrase pairs that are important for MRR signal. If dedupe collapsed paraphrases in prod but not in onboard, metrics will diverge. I've created a lock: `/golden/locks/qr4b_paraphrase_onboard.lock` — no golden edits until we reconcile. :lock:
Priya: EvalBot posted canary summary: `EvalBot: canary 4907654321: qr_4b-int8 vs float -> MRR:-4.9%, Recall@10:-6.0%, latency:+9%` (report -> /evals/4907654321/canary_summary.json)
Diego: latency +9% on int8 is odd; maybe hitting reference kernel fallback. Capture perf: `perf record -F 99 -a -g -- python serve_canary.py --model qr_4b-int8` and produce flamegraph.
Noor: quick embedding sanity: I compared cosine sim distributions on 1k docs: mean shift ~-0.065 between float and int8. that magnitude can change neighbor ordering. script: `python tools/compare_cosine.py --left float.npz --right int8.npz --out /tmp/cosine.png`
Eric: tokenizer/truncation rules may differ too. verify ingest config hash: `sha1sum data/ingest/config.yml` prod vs onboard. truncation boundaries can chop multi-sentence docs badly.
Taylor: labeler capacity is strained but we can run a targeted micro-campaign focussing on the paraphrase pairs from golden (78 pairs) + 120 synthetic pairs. Campaign draft: LF-2026037, items=198, priority=urgent. ETA 72h.
Priya: action items: 1) run shingle diff and surface top-50 near-dup mismatches, 2) rebuild FAISS with ef=200 and run recall curves, 3) run targeted canary only on locked golden pairs + random holdout, 4) if regression persists, escalate to quant infra for kernel regression.
EvalBot: [note] targeted-golden-run scheduled (+35m) -> output /evals/4907654321/targeted_golden.json
Diego: I'll draft a rollback playbook in case we need to route rerank to float: `/runbooks/qr4b_rollback.md` with k8s annotation flip and faiss swap steps.
Noor: quick repro for neighbor reorder: `python tools/neighbor_check.py --q pair_A12.q --left float.index --right int8.index --topk 25` and paste neighbor lists here. will help pinpoint whether embeddings or index params are culprit.
Priya: thanks — locking this thread as canonical. check back after EvalBot targeted run and after LF campaign goes live. :mag:
EvalBot: [update] targeted-golden-run completed: MRR delta on locked subset = -1.0% (reduced). full details -> /evals/4907654321/targeted_golden.json
Priya: delta shrink on locked subset implies sampling/index/build contributed significantly. proceed with FAISS rebuild + shingle cleanup, then re-run full canary. follow-up in 3h.
